title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的 feed 指向同一个变化：AI 不只是让旧工作更快，而是在重写“什么值得做”以及组织该如何准备。Amjad Masad 说，能被表达成 coding problem 的问题几乎都已被攻克；Aaron Levie 则提醒，真正有机会的产品，往往是今天勉强可行、但随着 capability 和 token volume 增长会突然成立的东西。与此同时，软件工厂的瓶颈开始转向 review、testing 和 QA，创业判断也重新变得比“会不会 build”更重要。

archive.title: 能力跃迁日报
archive.desc: AI 正同时改变产品机会、软件工厂和组织训练方式，builder 的稀缺能力从写代码转向判断做什么以及如何把系统搭起来。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Rebuilt from the 2026-09-08 source feeds.

sections.title: The New Bottleneck / 新瓶颈
sections.desc: 当 build 变得越来越容易，稀缺资源就从执行速度转向问题选择和产品判断。

rewrite: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari argues that as building gets easier, deciding what to build becomes the real bottleneck. AI-native organizations may not need many people, but the few who choose the right problems will need to be exceptionally well set up.
original:
More and more people are coming to the same conclusion..

As building gets easier, what to build becomes the important bottle neck. 

You might not need many of them, but the good ones are extremely well setup for the AI native organizations.

rewrite: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 认为，随着 build 变容易，真正的瓶颈变成了决定做什么。AI-native 组织可能不需要很多人，但那些能选对问题的人，必须被非常好地配置起来。
original: 越来越多人得出同一个结论：随着构建变容易，做什么变成了重要瓶颈。你可能不需要很多人，但优秀的人会非常适合 AI-native 组织。

rewrite: Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan pushes back on treating Requests for Startups as a formula. They are hunches and conversation starters; the outcome still depends on specific founders building specific technology for specific customers. The category is less important than the fit between people, product, and demand.
original:
It’s fair to say RFS are just hunches on what might be next, and conversation starters for people starting out. 

The main determiner of a startup idea’s success are the specific founders building specific tech for specific customers. The rest is categorization.

rewrite: Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan 不把 Requests for Startups 当成创业公式。它们只是对下一步可能发生什么的猜测和讨论起点，结果仍取决于具体的 founder 为具体客户做出具体技术。分类不如人、产品和需求之间的匹配重要。
original: 可以说，RFS 只是对未来可能发生什么的猜测，也是给刚开始的人提供的讨论起点。决定创业想法成败的，主要是具体 founder 为具体客户构建具体技术。其余都只是分类。

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie says the best AI opportunities may look almost economically impossible today. Builders should design for several orders of magnitude more capability or token volume, while still delivering some value now. The strategic move is to start with a barely-possible use case whose full mission becomes obvious as the models improve.
original:
Good reminder here that with rapidly accelerating AI progress, you should likely be building with a vision that contemplates at least a few orders of magnitude of capability improvement or token volume available to you.

The best opportunities right now are those where you can value to customers today with things that are barely only possible, but with a full mission that feels nearly impossible with today’s tech.

There are lots of products the require orders of magnitude more processing of data (and thus are barely economically viable ideas) or where model capabilities still are in their infancy relative to what’s needed. Best to be building for those scenarios.

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie 提醒，最好的 AI 机会今天看起来可能几乎不具备经济性。产品应该面向未来几个数量级的 capability 或 token volume 增长，同时现在就能给客户一点价值。更聪明的打法，是从一个“勉强可行”的入口开始，押注模型进步后整个使命会变得成立。
original: 一个很好的提醒：面对快速加速的 AI 进步，构建产品时最好考虑未来 capability 或 token volume 至少提升几个数量级。现在最好的机会，是今天只能勉强做到、但完整使命看起来几乎超出当前技术能力的那些东西。很多产品需要数量级更多的数据处理，经济上勉强可行，或者模型能力相对需求还处在早期。最好就是为这些场景构建。

sections.title: The Software Factory Rebuilds / 软件工厂重构
sections.desc: AI 写代码之后，验证代码、观察结果和维护反馈回路，正在成为新的基础设施战场。

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch describes the next bottleneck in software engineering as review, testing, and QA. That is why agent-browser is adding high-quality video recording: an autonomous software factory needs observable evidence of what the agent actually did, not just a generated diff.
original:
Your software factory needs high quality video recording. 𝚊𝚐𝚎𝚗𝚝-𝚋𝚛𝚘𝚠𝚜𝚎𝚛 delivers.

We’re shipping more functionality derived from the lessons of automating the new bottleneck in software engineering: review, testing and QA.

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 认为，软件工程的新瓶颈是 review、testing 和 QA。因此 agent-browser 正加入高质量录像：自主软件工厂需要能观察 agent 到底做了什么，而不只是看一份生成出来的 diff。
original: 你的软件工厂需要高质量的视频录制。agent-browser 可以做到。我们正在发布更多功能，这些功能来自自动化软件工程新瓶颈的经验：review、testing 和 QA。

rewrite: Peter Steinberger questions the old pull-request workflow: if an agent already wrote the prompt and made the change, why should a human ping another agent so someone else’s agent can merge it? The uncomfortable implication is that agent-to-agent handoffs may preserve bureaucracy long after the original human bottleneck is gone.
original:
Did a PR to one of our upstream projects and they requested some minor changes.

What’s even the point with this workflow? You already wrote the prompt, why make me ping my agent again so your agent then merges?

rewrite: Peter Steinberger 开始质疑传统的 pull request 流程：既然 agent 已经写好了 prompt 并完成修改，为什么还要让人再 ping 一次自己的 agent，最后由对方的 agent 合并？更刺耳的含义是，原本的人类瓶颈消失后，agent 之间的交接可能仍在复制官僚流程。
original: 我给上游项目提了一个 PR，对方要求做一些小修改。这个流程到底有什么意义？prompt 已经是你写的了，为什么还要让我再 ping 我的 agent，然后你的 agent 再合并？

sections.title: AI as Organizational Practice / AI 变成组织习惯
sections.desc: 真正的 AI adoption 不只是买工具，而是让领导者、员工和流程都开始围绕新能力重排。

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad draws a provocative boundary: he does not think we have reached AGI, but a tireless programmer makes systems functionally similar to it for problems that can be framed as code. The practical point is less about the label than about how many real-world tasks can now be translated into a form machines can relentlessly work on.
original:
I don’t think we’ve reached AGI but what we have is functionally indistinguishable from AGI.

Because we have a relentless programmer that doesn’t get bored or tired.

So any problem that can be casted as a coding problem is virtually solved.

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 划了一条有争议但很实用的边界：他不认为 AGI 已经到来，但一个不会厌倦、不会疲惫的 programmer，已经让那些能被表达成代码的问题在功能上接近 AGI。重点不在标签，而在于越来越多现实任务可以被翻译成机器能够持续处理的形式。
original: 我不认为我们已经达到 AGI，但现有东西在功能上已经和 AGI 难以区分。因为我们有一个不会无聊、不会疲惫的 relentless programmer。所以任何能被表达成 coding problem 的问题，几乎都已经解决。

rewrite: Rauch’s second signal is cultural: his personal $1,000 grants to 35 contributors center on agent skills and tools, local AI, performance, high-quality foundations, and unusual experiments. The list treats skills as a serious form of software and suggests that the AI ecosystem still needs durable primitives, not only flashy demos.
original:
I’m announcing v2 of my open source grants of $1,000USD to 35 awesome contributors. The themes:

① Agent skills & tools
Skills are now a valuable form of software, like Emil's world-class design eng work. Projects like 𝚙𝚐𝚋𝚘𝚝, 𝚔𝚗𝚒𝚙, 𝚞𝚗𝚕𝚒𝚐𝚑𝚝𝚑𝚘𝚞𝚜𝚎 create amazing AI engineering loops.

② Local AI
Projects like 𝚜𝚕𝚘𝚝𝚜𝚝𝚛𝚎𝚊𝚖, 𝙻𝚘𝚌𝚊𝚕𝙰𝙸, and 𝚌𝚘𝚕𝚒𝚋𝚛𝚒 are making inference not just a demo but for many a real and growing utility. Exciting to watch local AI unfold.

③ Performance
There's no excuse for software to be slow anymore.

④ High quality foundations
AI is still at its best when it can reuse great components than regenerating every time from first principles.

⑤ Cool experiments
I couldn't resist donating to a 'Finance terminal in the terminal', or beautiful funky things like 𝚍𝚒𝚝𝚑𝚎𝚛-𝚔𝚒𝚝.

rewrite: Rauch 的另一条信号是文化层面的：他给 35 位 contributor 发放个人开源资助，主题包括 agent skills 和 tools、local AI、性能、高质量基础设施，以及各种有趣实验。这份名单把 skill 当成严肃的软件形态，也说明 AI 生态需要可复用的 durable primitives，而不只是漂亮 demo。
original: 我宣布第二期个人开源资助：给 35 位优秀 contributor 每人 1,000 美元。主题包括：① Agent skills 和 tools，skill 现在是有价值的软件形态；② Local AI，让 inference 不只是 demo，而是真实且不断增长的工具；③ Performance，软件不该再慢；④ High quality foundations，AI 最擅长复用优秀组件，而不是每次从 first principles 重生；⑤ Cool experiments。

rewrite:
The takeaway: AI adoption becomes real when the CEO treats it as an organizational responsibility, not an optional productivity experiment. Will England, CEO/CIO and managing partner of the nearly $10B hedge fund Walleye, started an internal AI program two years ago and made baseline proficiency a firm-wide expectation.

His playbook is unusually concrete: train everyone, run informal weekly meetups, share prompts and use cases, surface internal champions, and use data to make progress visible. He argues that leaders must prepare people for what is coming while also admitting that the answers are not fully known. His phrase captures the stance: “Using ChatGPT is not cheating... we should be ashamed to leave money on the table by ignoring tools that make us faster, smarter, and more effective.”

核心 takeaway：当 CEO 把 AI 当成组织责任，而不是可有可无的效率实验，adoption 才会真正发生。近 100 亿美元规模的 hedge fund Walleye 的 CEO、CIO 和 managing partner Will England 两年前就启动内部 AI 项目，并把全员具备基础能力设成组织预期。

他的做法很具体：培训所有人、每周做非正式交流、分享 prompt 和 use case、鼓励内部 champion，再用数据让进展可见。他认为领导者必须帮助员工准备迎接变化，同时承认答案还没有完全确定。他的一句话概括了这种态度：「使用 ChatGPT 不是作弊……如果忽略让我们更快、更聪明、更有效率的工具，我们应该为把钱留在桌上而感到羞愧。」

sections.title: The Human Layer / 人的那一层
sections.desc: 模型能力越强，问题越不只是“能不能做”，还包括谁来判断、谁来负责，以及我们愿意如何生活。

rewrite: Anthropic philosopher and ethicist Amanda Askell imagines an email address that autonomous models could contact for moral guidance. The joke about needing a reverse CAPTCHA is also a compact design problem: any future system for machine ethics has to distinguish an actual autonomous model from a human directing one to evade the rules.
original: It would be cool to set up an email address that autonomous AI models could reach out to if they were looking for moral guidance. But it would require a reverse captcha that can detect that you're neither a human nor an AI being instructed to break it by a human.

rewrite: Anthropic 哲学家和 ethicist Amanda Askell 想象过这样一个邮箱：自主 AI 模型在需要道德指导时可以主动联系。她关于 reverse CAPTCHA 的玩笑，其实也是一个紧凑的设计问题：任何机器伦理系统，都得区分真正自主的模型和被人指挥来规避规则的模型。
original: 如果设置一个邮箱，让自主 AI 模型在寻找道德指导时可以联系它，会很酷。但这需要一个 reverse CAPTCHA，能够检测联系者既不是人类，也不是被人类指示去破解 CAPTCHA 的 AI。
